descriptionChirho: Describes a person or group as morally upright, just, and righteous in character or conduct.
Describes an action, judgment, path, or abstract thing as right, correct, or proper — what is morally or practically fitting.
Describes a physical or metaphorical path, road, or way as straight, direct, or level.
Used as a proper name or title, particularly in reference to the 'Book of Yashar' (Sepher ha-Yashar).
Used abstractly to denote the quality of uprightness, rectitude, or moral straightness.
Used substantively in the plural to refer to upright, right, or just things or words.
